name: Sticky piston shutter
explanation: An off lever leaves the aperture open. Power extends a sticky piston and pushes its stone payload into the aperture; removing power pulls the payload back.

stages.title: Place the support and payload
stages.explanation: Place the power support and separate stone payload; keep the aperture empty.

stages.title: Install the sticky piston
stages.explanation: Place the retracted sticky piston facing from its power support toward the payload and aperture.

stages.title: Add the off lever
stages.explanation: Place an off floor lever on the power support. Actuation requires a separate authorized transaction.

tests.description: Observe actual aperture, payload, piston and head through off/on/off cycles, allowing eight game ticks to settle and requiring eight stable ticks per state.
